teucrum: Teucrī, -ōrum (m. pl.) — Teucrians, Trojans (gen. pl., archaic -um for -ōrum)
tibi: tū, tuī — you (sg.); tibi, to/for you (dat.)
torquet: torqueō, torquēre, torsī, tortum — to twist, whirl, hurl (3rd sg. pres.)
transtra: trānstrum, -ī (n.) — cross-beam, thwart, rower's bench (acc./nom. pl.)
tris: trēs, tria — three (m./f. acc. pl., = trēs)
tristes: tristis, -e — sad, sorrowful, gloomy (f./m. nom. pl.)
tritonia: Trītōnia, -ae (f.) — the Tritonian, i.e. Pallas Athena (nom. sg.)
troianos: Trōiānus, -a, -um — Trojan, of Troy (m. acc. pl.)
troianus: Trōiānus, -a, -um — Trojan, of Troy (m. nom. sg.)
tuaque: tuus, -a, -um — your, yours (sg.) (f. abl. sg., with dextrā) + -que 'and' · also n. acc. pl. (tuaque arma) + -que
tum: tum (adv.) — then, at that time; next
tuum: tuus, -a, -um — your, yours (sg.) (m. acc. sg.; n. nom./acc. sg.)
udo: ūdus, -a, -um — wet, moist, sodden (m./n. abl. sg.)
umbrae: umbra, -ae (f.) — shadow, shade (nom. pl.; gen./dat. sg.)
unum: ūnus, -a, -um — one, a single, the same (n. nom./acc. sg.; m. acc. sg.)
vale: valeō, -ēre, -uī — to be well, be strong; valē, farewell (sg. imper.)
vel: vel (conj., adv.) — or; even; vel… vel, either… or
venti: ventus, -ī (m.) — wind (nom. pl.; gen. sg.) · also voc. pl., in address (sine nūmine, ventī)
vero: vērō (adv.) — in truth, indeed, but; tum vērō, then indeed
verrunt: verrō, -ere, verrī, versum — to sweep, skim (3rd pl. pres.)
vertice: vertex, verticis (m.) — peak, summit; whirl (abl. sg.)
vestae: Vesta, -ae (f.) — Vesta, goddess of the hearth (gen. sg.; also dat. sg.)
vicina: vīcīnus, -a, -um — neighbouring, near (n. acc./nom. pl.; f. nom./abl. sg.)
vires: vīs (f.) — force; pl. vīrēs, strength (acc. pl.) · also nom. pl. (fractae vīrēs)
visa: videō, vidēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see (perf. pass. part., f. nom. sg.; n. nom./acc. pl.)
vita: vīta, -ae (f.) — life, living; the breath of life (nom. sg.; also abl. sg.)
vivit: vīvō, -ere, vīxī, victum — to live, be alive, endure (3rd sg. pres.)
vocare: vocō, -āre, -āvī, -ātum — to call, name, summon (pres. inf.)
vocat: vocō, -āre — to call, name, summon (3rd sg. pres.)
vocatis: vocō, -āre, -āvī, -ātum — to call, summon (perf. pass. part., m./f./n. abl. pl.)
voces: vōx, vōcis (f.) — voice, word, utterance (acc. pl.; also nom. pl.)
vocibus: vōx, vōcis (f.) — voice; word, utterance (abl./dat. pl.)
volentem: volō, velle, voluī — to wish, be willing (pres. part., m./f. acc. sg.)
volunt: volō, velle, voluī — to wish, want, be willing (3rd pl. pres.)
